text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The February Stakes the other day was good.
But today's Teio Sho... can they win?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Well, if they take 1st place here just like they declared, they'd be the real deal, but I wonder how it'll go~.

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text: "...I've been listening to you run your mouth! Hey! Falco-chan's already the real deal, damn it! Have you even watched all her races?!"

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text: If you haven't seen it, watch it right now! This is the full race footage officially uploaded—

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Look!! Watch this!
Watch the live performance next too! C'mon!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Um, I look forward to working with you!
Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's both do our best~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Going out of your way to come say hello—our underclassmen really are such good girls☆"
choice_data_list: You're practically a big shot now.
You've become quite the veteran presence, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Hold on, hold on!
Falco's still in the prime of her career, you know!?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Calling me an industry veteran, huh...
Well, I suppose I really am a senior pro by now.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I figured I gotta pave the way for the girls who'll be giving it their all after me~

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"To make all the Umamusume feel
like they want to succeed on the dirt—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's gotta create a world
where everyone aims for the dirt tracks!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll go win as the strong Falco
that all my juniors look up to!!
